 Zach LaVine puts up 28 in loss to Clippers 
 by Garrett Ball | Kings Correspondent | Thu, Oct 22nd 2026, 8:18am EDT 
 Zach LaVine scored 28 points (10-19 FG, 3-8 3P, 5-8 FT) with four rebounds and four assists in the Kings 121-96 loss to the Clippers. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 LaVine led the Kings in scoring and had a decent amount of rebounds and assists, which is fine for nine-cat leagues. He’s not quite the volume scorer he used to be, which is a crazy thing to say after a 28 point outing, but he doesn’t have to be to bring value.
